      ABOUT THE STUDIO

      About Desktopcraft

      Learn to build desktop applications through guided lessons, editable code, interactive previews, and community projects.


      Desktopcraft was made originally in 2026 for learning Java swing, it used to be called Swingcraft


      But when I made it have multiple languages, it became Desktopcraft. Before it was for me to learn with people, now it is used to make applications and learn, also it was made so people could build together in one place, it did that well with a Forum, App maker, and public App-creator.
